ONES = [0] * 17
ONES[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 17):
    ONES[i] = 10 * ONES[i - 1] + 1

def compute(x):
    return find_min_cost(x, 16)

def find_min_cost(x, length):
    x = abs(x)
    if x % ONES[length] == 0:
        return (x // ONES[length]) * length
    low = x // ONES[length]
    high = low + 1

    cost1 = low * length + find_min_cost(x - low * ONES[length], length - 1)
    cost2 = high * length + find_min_cost(high * ONES[length] - x, length - 1)
    return min(cost1, cost2)
